RosPinyin — vendor reference notice
===================================

Directory: vendor/mzimeja-ref/
Upstream : https://github.com/katahiromz/mzimeja
Tag      : v1.0.0.3 (commit 8a12aab657, 2026-01-03T06:47:50Z)
Obtained : 2026-11-13, from codeload.github.com tarball
License  : Public Domain Software (PDS), per LICENSE.txt in that tag:
           "This software is public domain software (PDS). ...
            Copyright (C) 2016-2017 Katayama Hirofumi MZ"

Purpose
-------
Read-only architectural reference for M1 (IMM32 state machine, IME UI
window framework, .def export list, CMake layout). This tree is NOT built,
NOT linked into rospinyin.ime, and NOT shipped in any release package.

Why this tag
------------
Upstream relicensed on 2026-01-12 22:30 UTC (commit fbc986d71) from PDS
to GPLv3. The README.md GPLv3 statement appeared even earlier
(2026-01-04/05, Vibrato integration). v1.0.0.3 is the last tag whose
LICENSE.txt is PDS and whose README carries no GPL statement at all:
unambiguous, and its ime/ skeleton is complete (34 files) without Vibrato.

DO NOT copy code, resources or dictionary data from:
  - v1.0.0.4+ / v1.0.0.6 (README already says GPLv3, LICENSE conflicts)
  - v1.0.0.7+ (LICENSE.txt is GPLv3)
  - v1.0.1.1 (the GPLv3 binary used only for M0 black-box testing)
...unless decision D1 is explicitly changed to "accept GPLv3", in which
case this notice and the project's own license must be updated together.

See: ../M0-REPORT.md section 5.2 and ../README.md section 9.
